latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Upwork Proposal Coach skill.
- Provides step-by-step coaching to diagnose and improve proposal replies, job selection, pricing, and pipeline math for Upwork, Fiverr Pro, Toptal, Contra, and Catalant.
- Includes Upwork-first proposal structure, first-line hooks, job filtering criteria, profile hygiene checklist, and rate strategy.
- Covers latest (2026) Upwork algorithm factors: connects, JSS, BSS, profile completeness, badges, and ethical search ranking optimization.
- Supports proposal rewrites for cold outbound on LinkedIn/email for freelance client acquisition.
